title: 10% off Ultimate Her, Him, Teens, Kids and Students Gift Cards (In-Store Only) @ Coles
body:
Deal: 10% off Ultimate Her, Him, Teens, Kids and Students Gift Cards (In-Store Only) @ Coles

[poppingtags] Dang, a bit annoying that the deal doesn't extend into November when you actually know what you want to buy!
[InLaymansTerms] In this economy. People will be fighting for these like toilet paper during Covid.
Chaos.
[daanish] Interesting technique.
Personally I prefer elbows out and shoulders back to take up the most space as I barge through the door and barrel over the more feeble shoppers.
[The Value] The Peacock. Risky but clean if you can pull it off.
[HairyChickens] Did the security on these get better or do they still cause GCHS?
[browser] Nice, hopefully will coincide with a sale and obtainable.
[viirgon] So only $50 value cards? That's annoying.
[The Value] No more gatekeeping.
Head to affluent suburbs. They have always had plenty of stock.
[DevilsInDetails] What a sad way to learn I’ve been living in a..uh..third world suburb.
[ToniGee] Unethical life hack.
Go a few days early and hide the cards, go back and buy them when the special starts.
[Owgasm] Pokemon UPCs! Wooo!
Do we know if it’s 5 per day? Or 5 per flybuys account?
[cloudy] pretty much the same deal on as woolies right now? except you get it in points…
[King Steuart] Easier to find IKEA exchangeable ones at woolies this week. The student ones sell out
[Oct31Dec25] Can I use these to buy apple gift cards at jb hifi/officeworks? Thanks.
[WookieMonster] Read this comment I posted in the other Ultimate gift card deal earlier today.
[Oct31Dec25] So there is a chance at JB Hi-Fi. Thanks, mate.
[Smokey010] Can’t use any Ultimate GC at Officworks to buy technology products? This is annoying.
[WookieMonster] That is only if you are trying to purchase from the online store. (You can also only redeem one Ultimate gift card in one online transaction anyway, as Officeworks' website cannot handle split payments across multiple Ultimate gift cards (i.e. multiple Visa cards) in the same transaction.)
If you go in-store, you will be able to purchase technology products with one or multiple Ultimate gift cards.
I am not sure if you will have issues with purchase technology products over the phone at 1300 OFFICE.
[Smokey010] If it works in-store, I am a happy man.
Thanks for replying. Cheers
[terroz] Is the norm now 10%? This used to be 15%
[browser] GCs cover JB hasn't seen 15% for a long time, like 2-3 years.
